ai.title: AI Data Center Developer LIAN Eyes IPO to Raise $500 Million
ai.description: LIAN Group, a developer of infrastructure for artificial intelligence and computing, is considering an initial public offering that could raise about $500 million.

ai.title: DeepMind Offshoot Emulate Closes In on $700 Million Seed Round
ai.description: A UK artificial intelligence startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers is in talks to raise $700 million in a seed round, in the latest example of investors backing alumni of notable AI labs.

ai.title: Oversight Board says Meta's rules for AI deepfakes are 'consistently and fundamentally inadequate'
ai.description: The Oversight Board is asking Meta to prioritize AI content when it's reported.

ai.title: Ripple adds XRP payments to Stripe and Tempo’s AI standard in new developer kit
ai.description: The update expands support for automated payments in XRP and RLUSD, with tools that let agents pay repeatedly for services and manage wallets across blockchains.

ai.title: The EU Wants to Break Up Kids and Their Chatbots
ai.description: ChatGPT, Character.ai, and Snapchat’s My AI will all be in the crosshairs as the AI Kids Act aims to strip minor-facing chatbots of all the things that make people love them.

ai.title: Europe Tech Fund Said In Talks to Back AI Startup ElevenLabs
ai.description: Europe’s new technology fund is in talks to invest in UK-based artificial intelligence startup ElevenLabs Inc., people with knowledge of the matter said.

ai.title: India Outsourcing Shifts Upmarket as AI Reshapes Jobs, ING Says
ai.description: India’s outsourcing industry is showing little sign of losing ground to artificial intelligence as the country moves up the value chain into services that are harder to automate, according to ING Bank NV.

ai.title: Port of LA's Seroka on AI, Trade & Supply Chains
ai.description: Port of Los Angeles Executive Director Gene Seroka unpacks how artificial intelligence is reshaping shipping and logistics. He also share insights on trade tariffs, shifting supply chains amid geopolitical risks. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: Pentagon CTO says U.S. government shouldn't take stakes in AI giants, questions adding AI rules
ai.description: President Donald Trump has angrily pushed back on the calls from industry and lawmakers for an AI slowdown or greater regulation.

business.title: Tim Cook keeping John Ternus away from controversy by attending White House dinner
business.description: One of the trickier parts of Tim Cook’s job when he was Apple CEO was walking the tightrope of upholding the company’s values without provoking the ire of the White House over things like immigration policy and DEI. His new role as executive chairman sees him retain responsibility for government liaison, offering replacement CEO John Ternus some degree of protection … more…

business.title: State Street Says Any Tech Weakness Is Chance to Rebuild
business.description: State Street Equity Research Head Marija Veitmane says she remains constructive on technology stocks, arguing that the sector’s strong earnings and profitability tell a favorable story despite the conversation about slowing down development of cutting-edge artificial intelligence models. "We strongly suspect that regulation is very likely to be kind of more supportive for larger companies," Veitmane tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
